explain.en: A reason explains WHY something happens. A result explains WHAT happens because of it. We use different linking words for each.
explain.ar: السبب يوضّح لماذا حدث الشيء، والنتيجة توضّح ما حدث بسببه. لكل منهما كلمات ربط مختلفة.

explain.title: Structure and punctuation
rows: We stayed home because it was very hot.
We stayed home because of the heat.
a clause; put a comma before it
It was very hot, so we stayed home.
a comma, then a clause; start a new sentence
It was very hot. Therefore, we stayed home.

explain.en: Because, since and as are followed by a clause. Because of and due to are followed by a noun. So comes in the middle of the sentence after a comma. Therefore, consequently and as a result begin a new sentence and are followed by a comma.
explain.ar: بعد because وsince وas نأتي بجملة كاملة (فاعل + فعل). وبعد because of وdue to نأتي باسم فقط. أما so فتأتي في وسط الجملة بعد فاصلة، بينما therefore وconsequently وas a result فتبدأ بها جملة جديدة ويليها فاصلة.

explain.en: Do not write because + noun or because of + clause. Do not use 'so' and 'because' together in the same sentence.
explain.ar: لا تكتب because قبل اسم ولا because of قبل جملة كاملة. ولا تستخدم so وbecause معًا في الجملة نفسها.

explain.en: We use will + the base verb (infinitive without 'to') to talk about the future. The form is the same for all subjects. The negative is will not = won't.
explain.ar: نستخدم will + الفعل في صورته الأساسية (بدون to) للتحدث عن المستقبل، وتبقى الصيغة نفسها مع كل الضمائر. والنفي هو will not ويُختصر إلى won't.

explain.title: Forms of will
rows: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Will it be hot? Yes, it will.

explain.title: When do we use will?
rows: Sea levels will rise in the future.
I will recycle these bottles, I promise.
I will carry the bags for you.
It is dark. I will switch on the light.

explain.en: We often use will with time words such as tomorrow, soon, next year, in the future, and with 'I think', 'probably' and 'maybe'.
explain.ar: نستخدم will كثيرًا مع كلمات الزمن مثل tomorrow وsoon وnext year وin the future، ومع عبارات مثل I think وprobably وmaybe.

items.en: I think electric cars will become cheaper.

items.en: We won't have enough water if it doesn't rain.
items.ar: لن يكون لدينا ماء كافٍ إذا لم تمطر.

items.en: Don't worry. I won't forget to turn off the lights.
items.ar: لا تقلق. لن أنسى إطفاء الأنوار.

items.en: Will the ice caps melt completely? No, they won't, but they will get smaller.
items.ar: هل ستذوب الأغطية الجليدية تمامًا؟ لا، لن تذوب، لكنها ستصغر.

explain.en: Never put 'to' after will: say 'It will rain', not 'It will to rain'. Do not add -s to the verb: 'She will help', not 'She will helps'. Do not confuse won't (will not) with want.
explain.ar: لا تضع to بعد will، فنقول It will rain وليس It will to rain. ولا تضف s للفعل بعد will. ولا تخلط بين won't (لن) وwant (يريد).
